asr.full_text: The one coin The One coin provides a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. The one coin is a crypto-currency born in the success of the bitcoin. It all started back in 2009 when the bitcoin got introduced and traded at 10 dollar cents per coin. Since then, it has been trading at over 1 thousand cents per coin, since then it has been trading it over $1,000 per coin and has increased in value more than 75 times since its introduction. The OneCoin, however, is much more than a cryptocurrency, it's a lifestyle concept offering unique opportunities for profitability and growth. This opportunity is only available through an invitation basis and provides a business platform and a financial education platform. OneCoin has the potential to become the most attractive cryptocurrency on the market. Due to its innovative approach and usability this can be the next bitcoin. Through our ONE Academy with its innovative approach in usability this can be the next bitcoin through our one academy you will learn how to trade in profit from cryptor currency through our interactive materials such as videos presentation and online quizzes all designed to make you profit from owning crypto currency do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire you don't need any prior skills about trading. Our program is designed in five levels with a simple step-by-step approach guiding you to success. All education packages contain free one tokens. The tokens can be traded on our exchange much like the stock market. All members profit from buying and selling tokens from each other. So, take this opportunity now while the price is still low and profit from the next cryptocurrency success. It's free to become a member, and join one. However, if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses you have to purchase any of our five product packages. Tycoon. Executive Trader. Pro Trader. Trader or Starter. Tycoon costs €5000. Executive Trader costs €3000. Pro trader costs €1000. Trader costs €3000 pro trader costs €1000 Traders costs €500 In our starter is €100 all our packages Include excellent educational material from one academy learn how to trade for profit buy low sell high trade your tokens, and profit. The WON tokens are included in the product packages as a free bonus. How can you make money with WON? There are nine different ways to profit from our bonus program. • The direct sales bonus • The Network bonus • The matching bonus • The start bonus the startup bonus 1 life points double your money with splits the gold bonus and our leadership program you also receive a free ewallet for safe and secure payments direct sales and network bonus you get 10% bonus on all personal sales associated to the business volume. That's BV. This means for every sale you make you get a direct sales bonus. The network bonus is accumulated on the weaker side of your sales team. You receive 10% of all business volume from your sales team the member that joins your team and with you as a sponsor will be placed on your right and your left side you decide left or right you can also let the system do this for you with our alternative setting matching bonus the matching bonus helps you grow your team and make you successful depending on what package and status you have you can earn up to generations of matching bonus and up to 25 percent startup bonus during your first 30 days from your first purchase on a product package you can receive an additional 10% on direct sales. So, keep your momentum and build your team because the clock is ticking. One Life Points. By joining early, you can collect one life points. Here, you can see how many points you can collect per day. So, join now as you collect more points from the people joining after you. Points can be redeemed for items such as holidays, luxury items and exclusive rewards. Splits, as the one tokens increase in price on our exchange, you will profit not only from the price increase but moreover through the split of the token. This means you double your amount of Tokens after a split by holding a tycoon status you can split up to two times that means four times your money gold bonus one has partnered up with the new type of cryptocurrency a soID currency. The first on the market to back up the currency with solid gold. As a bonus, you collect ALEM GOLD coins. Each coin is backed up with 1 milligram of solid gold. These coins you rceive for free as a member of ONE. Leadership program. ONE rewards you for being a top performer and joining our leadership program. The program gives you special promotions such as cars, luxury watches, and other life-changing experiences. So as you can see, One provides a very attractive bonus program for you to build a successful career. Join today and start building your team. Payout Conditions On this page you can read our bonus payout conditions. One pays out bonuses on a weekly basis. So keep track of your bonus payouts in your back office.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes OneCoin as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity and urges viewers to buy paid packages to obtain bonuses and profit. It presents earnings tied to sponsoring people, building a sales team, and receiving commissions across multiple generations, while also promising token appreciation and millionaire-making educational packages. These are direct participation and recruitment claims, not a warning or neutral description.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 is primary because the promoted earnings depend on a multi-person team structure: members are placed on the sponsor's left or right side, network volume is accumulated from the sales team, and matching bonuses can extend across multiple generations. S05 is separately evidenced by claims that OneCoin token price increases and splits will generate profit, while a paid earning-guidance cue is supported by paid product packages that include education explicitly marketed for earning profit.
